I haven't looked I'll take a look was this today? right now, the proofs take 40sec+ to arrive. 11447861 was >60sec yes looks like there's maybe a buildup in the prover queue <@466102668138512394> It seems all the queue wait spikes come from lighthouse sending `engine_newPayload` in bursts (e.g. the 08:28 UTC spike follows a burst of 30 late requests in 6.3s at 08:25:05). Each burst happens after lighthouse waits for missing data columns (mostly columns 74 and 125) before it can import a payload. Perhaps running our lighthouse as a supernode could fix this, since it rebuilds the missing columns directly? I'll add another chart to show the request/s received by `zkboost` so we can see this issue more directly in the future. are you sure its waiting for columns or could it be that its waiting for proofs? Probably it would be nice to run a Prysm prover as well in Sepolia to check if everything is alright.

excerpts.author: han0110
excerpts.content:
It seems all the queue wait spikes come from lighthouse sending `engine_newPayload` in bursts (e.g. the 08:28 UTC spike follows a burst of 30 late requests in 6.3s at 08:25:05). Each burst happens after lighthouse waits for missing data columns (mostly columns 74 and 125) before it can import a payload. Perhaps running our lighthouse as a supernode could fix this, since it rebuilds the missing columns directly?

I'll add another chart to show the request/s received by `zkboost` so we can see this issue more directly in the future.
